job_card_ownership.decision: Job Card remains a kiosk-facing projection of one wo_operation; no new aggregate is approved.

current_gaps: REST requests omit Authorization bearer token
Browser-controlled X-User-ID and X-Role-Code are trusted
Active session is React memory only and MOCK-* fallback exists
Print Station operation remains in the manual selector and form
Only Work Order list has IndexedDB fallback
Most list/detail text is not localized

commands.start: Creates IN_PROGRESS session, sets operation InProgress, writes OperationStarted; accepts Released or InProgress WO.
commands.confirm: Currently accepts InProgress or Pending, stores confirmation, sets session COMPLETED and operation Finished, writes OperationFinished.
commands.abort: Only sets the named session ABORTED; operation and Work Order are unchanged and no outbox event is written.

execution.completion: WO is Completed only when every operation is Finished and no IN_PROGRESS session exists.

gateway.routing: dispatch_mode=DEMO_SHARED_KIOSK routes only to KIOSK-DEMO-01; otherwise Work Center routing is used.
security_gaps: JWT is parsed without signature verification

print_station.success: Print job Completed, operation Finished, OperationFinished emitted, WO completion evaluated.
print_station.failure: Print job Failed and operation ExecutionError; no manual kiosk action is approved.

mes_console.detail_refresh: Initial load and explicit post-command/manual refresh only; no execution-event WebSocket subscription on Work Order detail.
mes_console.identity: Keycloak Authorization Code with PKCE exists, but detail API still builds browser-controlled identity headers.

runtime_baseline.root_cause_note: Kiosk migrations remain marked applied while the full reset preserves schema_migrations and truncates terminal data.
